data.name: Delta x Dungeon Breaker
data.detailed_description:
"Delta x Dungeon Breaker" - Your Main Character's Adventuring Party  

Role play as The Demon within a mortal prophet, Kaiza who leads dungeon breaker squad: "Delta X"

Guide "Kaiza", your main character, through a treacherous high fantasy world grappling with the looming threat of Dungeon Breaks that grows each day. Gather adventurers, train, fight, and die while traversing a deep narrative puzzle on your quest to stop the dungeon breaks! 

Combat plays out in real time but pause at will to line up the exact moves of each member. Every decision, political and personal, feeds a world that keeps track: factions remember who backed them, karma catches up with choices made regions ago, and the consequences of your prophet's path ripple long after the moment has passed.

And when your prophet falls, that isn't the end of your story. It's the start of the next one. Death carries meta-progression forward for your prophet.

Shonen Fantasy

  • Power Scaling: Train and improve attributes, finding magical items, and leveling up your party

  • Transform & Grow: Earn powerful physical transformations, but also grow personally and narratively alongside characters who've joined you

  • Moral Code: fight with conviction for what you believe, because will is inherited 

Narrative Puzzle

  • Lasting Consequences: Traverse the interactive narrative. Dialog and actions move you along thematic basis vectors that model abstract characteristics.

  • Party Builder: who you fight alongside or against matters; party composition makes or breaks a run

  • Replayability: Explore timelines by creating new futures & returning to past plot-points. Save scumming is okay

Tactical Combat

  • Fighting is Normal: violently liberate societies because of personal conflicts with institutions.

  • Hack & Slash: kill hostile monsters frequently

  • Death matters: die and witness the death of beloved characters with lasting consequences

Features

  • Train skills and attributes

  • Find masters to learn new training regimens

  • Kill monsters, find magical items, and grow your adventuring party

  • Learn about characters and their contexts through dialog

  • Ask closely aligned NPCs to join you

  • Many NPCs are hostile to you, and all may become hostile

  • Key dialog choices mutate target hostility

  • Characters tend to say things they hear

  • A deep, ongoing simulation tracks factions, political alliances, and personal karma

  • Rapid decision making that navigates a narrative puzzle

  • NPCs come in and out of the fog of war based on narrative state

  • Spending time incurs looming threats

  • NPCs may fight, but most will run or submit before death

  • Compete against (non-player) characters for resources
